import random

scene.lights = []
lamp = local_light(pos=vector(0,0,0),
                      color=color.white)
sun=sphere(pos=vec(0,0,0), emissive=True, color=vec(1,0.6,0), radius=100)                      

earth=sphere(pos=vec(300,0,0), radius=25, color=vec(0,0,1))

mercury=sphere(pos=vec(150,0,0), radius=12, color=vec(0.5,0.5,0.5))

venus=sphere(pos=vec(200,0,0), radius=24, color=vec(1,1,0))

mars=sphere(pos=vec(420,0,0), radius=18, color=vec(1,0.3,0.2))

moon=sphere(pos=vec(260,0,0), radius=6, color=vec(0.5,0.5,0.5))

jupiter=sphere(pos=vec(900,0,0), radius=70, color=vec(1,0.8,0.5))

saturn=sphere(pos=vec(1300,0,0), radius=56, color=vec(1,0.8,0.7))

uranus=sphere(pos=vec(1500,0,0), radius=35, color=vec(0.7,0.7,1))

neptune=sphere(pos=vec(1800,0,0), radius=33, color=vec(0.3,0.3,1))




ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=150, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=200, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=300, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=420, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=900, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=1300, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=1500, thickness=0.4)
ring(pos=vector(0,0,0), axis=vector(0,0,1), radius=1800, thickness=0.4) 


ast=[]
for q in range(-851,851) :
    x = random.randint(-1000,1000)
    y = random.randint(-1000,1000)
    if x**2+y**2 >= 520**2 and x**2+y**2 <= 850**2 :
        z = random.randint(-50,50)
        l = random.randint(0,10)
        h = random.randint(0,10)
        w = random.randint(0,10)
        asteroid = ellipsoid(pos = vec(x,y,z), length=l, height=h, width=w, color=vec(0.6,0.6,0.6))
        ast.append(asteroid)
        
k=0
t=0
l=0
m=0
n=0
u=0
i=0
o=0
p=0

while True :
    rate(500)
    t+=0.001
    earth.pos = vec(300*cos(t), 300*sin(t), 0)
    
    k+=0.004
    mercury.pos = vec (150*cos(k), 150*sin(k), 0)

    l+=0.0016
    venus.pos = vec(200*cos(l), 200*sin(l), 0)

    m+=0.0005
    mars.pos = vec(420*cos(m), 420*sin(m), 0)

    ex=300*cos(t)
    ey=300*sin(t)
    
    n+=0.0135
    moon.pos = vec(ex-40*cos(n), ey-40*sin(n), 0)
    
    u+=0.00008
    jupiter.pos = vec(900*cos(u), 900*sin(u), 0)
    
    i+=0.00005
    saturn.pos = vec(1300*cos(i), 1300*sin(i), 0) 
    
    o+=0.000024
    uranus.pos = vec(1500*cos(o), 1500*sin(o), 0)
    
    p+=0.000012
    neptune.pos = vec(1800*cos(p), 1800*sin(p), 0)
    
    sun.rotate(angle=0.3, axis=vec(0,0,1), origin=vec(0,0,0))
    
    for c in ast :
        v=random.randint(0,40)
        c.rotate(angle=v/200000, axis=vec(0,0,1), origin=vec(0,0,0))
